meta.title: Recreate Order with a different delivery location
gaps: Independently assert that the original closed RFQ remains unchanged after the recreated order is created
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Independently assert that the original closed RFQ remains unchanged after the recreated order is created

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's project summary.
Choose Recreate Order from the event's stage settings menu.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order flow, change Delivery location to Gurgaon, click Create Order, and verify the new event is created while the original closed RFQ remains unchanged

steps.note: Perform the buyer-only recreate flow and create the new order with the requested delivery location.
Assert that the resulting screen shows Gurgaon as the delivery location.
